text: Sandbox merchant accounts and test cards simulate payment scenarios, including successful, failed, and 3D Secure flows
quote: SumUp provides sandbox merchant accounts and a comprehensive set of test cards to simulate various payment scenarios, including different 3D Secure authentication flows.

text: Virtual Solo simulates a Solo card reader so pairing and checkout can be tested with a sandbox account before using a physical reader
quote: Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later

text: In-person payments can be integrated three ways: Cloud API, Reader SDKs, or Payment Switch
quote: There are three ways to integrate SumUp in-person payments: | | Cloud API | Reader SDKs | Payment Switch |

text: Cloud API lets a POS on any platform start a transaction over HTTPS and complete it on a Solo (or Go) reader
quote: The Cloud API lets you start a transaction from a Point of Sale (POS) running on any platform (Windows, iOS, Linux, Android, Web-based, etc.) capable of sending HTTPS requests and complete that transaction via a Solo reader.

text: Multiple Solo card readers can process transactions simultaneously
quote: Ability to process simultaneous transactions on multiple Solo card readers at once

text: There is no distance limit between the POS and the Solo reader, so transactions can be sent remotely
quote: No distance limitation between your POS device and the Solo card reader; transactions can be sent remotely

text: Multiple Solo readers can be paired with any SumUp account, and each reader can be named
quote:
Pairing multiple Solo card readers with any SumUp account
- Naming each Solo card reader as desired to streamline checkout

text: Tap to Pay accepts contactless payments directly on a compatible phone, with no separate card reader
quote: Tap to Pay lets merchants accept in-person contactless payments directly on a compatible phone without carrying a separate card reader.

text: Card payments can be taken in person using physical card readers or Tap to Pay on a mobile device
quote: SumUp's in-person payment products let you accept card payments face-to-face using physical card readers or Tap to Pay on a mobile device.

text: Offline store-and-forward mode caches card data securely on the device and uploads it for authorization once connectivity returns
quote: Offline Transactions let merchants continue accepting card payments when internet connectivity is unavailable or unreliable. In this store-and-forward flow, card data is captured and cached securely on the device, then uploaded later for pr

text: A managed MCP server lets MCP clients use SumUp APIs and documentation tools to manage the account, create checkouts, or process payments
quote: SumUp runs a managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp. This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments using Cloud API.

text: AI assistants can be used to build SumUp integrations, troubleshoot checkout flows, or query the merchant account
quote: Use your AI assistant to build SumUp payment integrations, troubleshoot checkout flows, or query your merchant account.

text: The Agent Toolkit adds SumUp API tools to agent apps built with LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or MCP
quote: The SumUp Agent Toolkit adds SumUp API tools to agentic applications built with LangChain, AI SDK, the OpenAI Agents SDK, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

text: An MCP adapter lets developers embed SumUp tools in their own MCP server
quote: Use the MCP adapter when embedding SumUp tools in your own MCP server.

text: The AI SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK adapters require approval before running tools that modify data
quote: The AI SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK adapters require approval before running tools that can modify data.

text: Agent toolkit adapters accept lifecycle callbacks for recording tool execution rate, errors, and duration
quote: Every adapter accepts optional lifecycle callbacks for recording tool execution rate, errors, and duration.

text: Any docs page can be fetched as plain Markdown by appending index.md to its URL
quote: You can access all of our documentation as plain text Markdown files by adding index.md to the end of any URL.

text: A bulk llms-full.txt file is provided for ingesting the documentation
quote: For bulk ingestion, use [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

text: The @sumup/sdk JavaScript package wraps the API, ships TypeScript types, and runs on Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and similar runtimes
quote: The `@sumup/sdk` package wraps SumUp API, ships TypeScript declarations, and works in modern JavaScript runtimes and platforms, including Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and other ESM-friendly environments.

text: The SDK client automatically reads the SUMUP_API_KEY environment variable for server deployments
quote: The client reads the `SUMUP_API_KEY` environment variable automatically, so deploying with `SUMUP_API_KEY=sup_sk_MvxmLOl0...` is enough for most server workloads.

text: Checkouts can be created and their status inspected through the API
quote: Create checkouts and inspect their status.

text: The API can list the payment methods available to a merchant and checkout
quote: Discover the methods available to a merchant and checkout.

text: The API can query the merchant profile and review transactions
quote: Query your merchant profile and review transactions.

text: Static API keys act on behalf of the merchant account with the full set of permissions
quote: Use them when you control the merchant account and need direct access to SumUp APIs with the full set of permissions.

text: OAuth 2.0 is supported for integrations that other merchants or their staff authorize
quote: Use [OAuth 2.0](/tools/authorization/oauth/) when you build an integration that other merchants or their staff will authorize.

text: Checkout status-change notifications can be subscribed to by setting a return_url when creating the checkout
quote: At this time our system only allows you to get notified about a status change for a checkout. To subscribe to an event, specify a `return_url` parameter upon checkout creation.

text: Previously processed transactions can be refunded in full or in part
quote: In this guide, you will learn how to refund a transaction... Option A: Make a full refund... Option B: Make a partial refund

text: Hosted Checkout sends customers to a SumUp-hosted payment page via a redirect URL
quote: Hosted Checkout is the fastest path to launch. SumUp hosts the payment page, while your integration creates the checkout and redirects the customer to the returned URL.

text: The Payment Widget embeds checkout on your own site by adding a single script
quote: For an embedded checkout on your own site, use the [Payment Widget]. It only requires adding a single script to your payment page.

text: Reader SDKs embed payments in Android or iOS apps, controlling the reader over Bluetooth or using Tap to Pay
quote: Embed payment acceptance directly in your Android or iOS app. Your app controls the reader over Bluetooth or uses Tap to Pay.

text: Payment Switch hands payment acceptance off to the SumUp app and returns to your app when the payment is done
quote: Hand off payment acceptance from your app to the SumUp app, then return to your app when the payment is done.

text: An Apple Pay merchant session can be created for a checkout
quote: Creates an Apple Pay merchant session for the specified checkout.

text: The OpenAPI specification is available for download
quote: [Download the OpenAPI specification](/openapi.json).

text: Pricing has no monthly minimums or hidden fees, with standard transaction fees on any device
quote: You’ll never pay monthly minimums or hidden fees – ever.

text: Purchases are backed by a money-back guarantee
quote: with our money-back guarantee, you can invest with confidence, knowing your hard-earned cash is always protected

text: A higher POS tier adds customer rewards, automated marketing, and 2 monthly promotions
quote: Ideal for businesses ready to grow. Everything the POS offers plus customer rewards, automated marketing, and 2 monthly promotions.

text: Multiple stores can be managed from one back-office login
quote: Manage multiple stores from one back office login

text: POS supports multi-device sync and connecting several ticket printers
quote: Multi-device sync, and connect several ticket printers

text: Payment links, reporting, and invoicing are included
quote: Payment links, powerful reporting, invoicing, and more
